criteria.title: Problem definition
criteria.description: Clarity and justification of the problem and user needs.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: No coherent problem is established in the reviewed material.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A problem is named, but affected users and needs are largely unclear.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Problem and primary user need are understandable, with limited justification.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Clear user needs and a justified problem, with bounded omissions.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Specific, justified problem grounded in user needs and context.

criteria.title: Objectives
criteria.description: Specific, coherent and measurable project objectives.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: No coherent objectives are demonstrated.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Objectives are vague or inconsistent with the problem.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Main objectives are clear but not sufficiently measurable.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Specific coherent objectives with mostly clear success conditions.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Measurable, prioritized objectives linked to the problem and success criteria.

criteria.title: Scope and constraints
criteria.description: Intended users, boundaries, constraints and realistic scope.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed scope is incoherent or absent.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Important boundaries or constraints are unclear.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Main workflows and boundaries are understandable; constraints are incomplete.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Clear boundaries, users and realistic constraints with minor gaps.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Explicit in/out-of-scope requirements, assumptions, constraints and realistic boundaries.

criteria.title: Organization
criteria.description: Logical structure and coherent section organization.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed material is substantially disorganized.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Major structural gaps impair navigation and understanding.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Sections are broadly logical but transitions or ordering need work.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Coherent sections and logical progression with minor gaps.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Consistent, navigable organization that connects problem, design, evidence and conclusion.

criteria.title: Clarity and specificity
criteria.description: Precise, understandable and technically specific explanations.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Critical explanations are incomprehensible or contradictory.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Descriptions are vague with major technical omissions.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Readable explanations with limited concrete technical detail.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Clear, specific explanations with bounded omissions.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Precise, concise and technically detailed explanations appropriate to the audience.

criteria.title: Evidence presentation
criteria.description: Clear separation of claims, plans, measured results and limitations.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed report materially misrepresents results or lacks meaningful supporting evidence.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Claims and results are poorly distinguished.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Some evidence is presented but traceability or limitations are incomplete.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Claims, plans, observed results and limitations are clearly distinguished.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Traceable evidence, explicit scope, reproducibility context and accurate limitations support key claims.

criteria.title: Architecture
criteria.description: Coherent component boundaries and interactions.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: No coherent component architecture is demonstrated.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Components are named but interactions or responsibilities remain unclear.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Basic architecture and component interactions are understandable.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Coherent boundaries, interactions and responsibilities with bounded gaps.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Well-justified architecture with clear interfaces, responsibilities and relevant constraints.

criteria.title: Data and interfaces
criteria.description: Appropriate data models, contracts and interface design.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed data or interface design is substantially incoherent.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Key entities, contracts or interactions are poorly defined.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Basic entities and interfaces are described; important constraints are missing.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Coherent data model and interfaces with appropriate constraints.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Well-justified data and interface contracts, constraints and relevant error behavior.

criteria.title: Design decisions and trade-offs
criteria.description: Explicit rationale, constraints and consideration of alternatives.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed material gives no defensible design rationale.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Design decisions are asserted without meaningful reasoning.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Some choices are explained but alternatives and trade-offs are limited.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Important choices are justified against relevant constraints and alternatives.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Clear comparison of realistic alternatives, trade-offs, assumptions and constraints.

criteria.title: Implementation coherence
criteria.description: Source-supported features, responsibility separation and design realization.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Source-supported evidence establishes major implementation deficiencies.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Major design realization or component integration problems are supported.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Core implementation is plausible but important integration gaps remain.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Source-supported implementation coherently realizes core design with bounded concerns.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Source-supported realization is coherent and robust across reviewed components.

criteria.title: Maintainability
criteria.description: Structure, duplication, complexity and maintainability concerns; no automatic heuristic deductions.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed source establishes major maintainability impediments.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Material complexity, duplication or structure problems are supported.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Basic structure is understandable but material maintainability concerns remain.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Clear structure and responsibilities with bounded maintainability concerns.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Reviewed evidence supports maintainable structure, appropriate abstraction and clear responsibilities.

criteria.title: Security and reliability
criteria.description: Authorization, input handling, secrets and error handling; suspected static risks are not confirmed exploits.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed evidence establishes major security or reliability deficiencies.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Substantial source-supported risks or unreliable handling require remediation.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Relevant controls exist or are described, with material gaps requiring review.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Relevant controls are coherent with bounded concerns and explicit limitations.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Strong source-supported handling of relevant access, input, error and configuration concerns.

criteria.title: Coding standards
criteria.description: Source-supported coding conventions and formatting; distinguish minor style issues from material defects.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed source exhibits pervasive serious convention or readability problems.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Multiple material coding convention issues impair readability.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Generally readable style with recurring convention gaps.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Consistent style with minor or isolated issues.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Consistent readable conventions and formatting across reviewed source.

criteria.title: Source relevance
criteria.description: Relevance and quality of assignment-required sources.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Required source use is demonstrably absent or irrelevant.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Sources have weak relevance or quality.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Relevant sources exist but coverage or justification is limited.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Relevant credible sources are selected with clear rationale.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Well-chosen credible sources address key questions and limitations.

criteria.title: Critical synthesis
criteria.description: Critical comparison and integration of cited work.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: No required synthesis is demonstrated.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Sources are listed with little meaningful comparison.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Basic integration with limited critical analysis.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Relevant sources are compared and integrated with acknowledged limitations.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Critical synthesis contrasts findings and explains implications for project decisions.

criteria.title: Citation quality
criteria.description: Traceability, attribution and clarity of citations.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Required attribution or traceability is materially absent.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Major citation gaps obstruct traceability.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Most citations are understandable but some attribution or metadata is incomplete.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Clear traceable citation practice with minor gaps.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Consistent traceable attribution and bibliographic information support reviewed claims.

criteria.title: Selected functional scenario success
criteria.description: Score the outcomes of the explicitly selected reviewed scenarios only. Attribution and scope require teacher review.

criteria.title: Selected unauthenticated access check
criteria.description: Score the outcomes of the explicitly selected reviewed scenarios only. Attribution and scope require teacher review.

criteria.title: Selected database postcondition check
criteria.description: Score the outcomes of the explicitly selected reviewed scenarios only. Attribution and scope require teacher review.

criteria.title: Testing strategy and limitations
criteria.description: Assess the documented validation strategy, including clear expected outcomes, negative checks and honest limitations. Do not score executed correctness or penalize missing execution here.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed text contains no meaningful validation strategy or substantially misrepresents what was tested.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Very limited scenarios or no clear expected outcomes.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Useful scenarios and some expected outcomes, but incomplete negative cases or reproducibility details.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Clear representative scenarios and expected outcomes with explicit limitations and some negative checks.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Comprehensive requirements-linked strategy with concrete oracles, negative cases, reproducibility details and honest limitations.
